notes.title: BIG update 5.0!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31669450/fb8a3979e88976060fec2b6cca2822b02525ad3b.png[/img]



[h3]Hello everyone!

We're excited to announce that Aircraft Evolution has been updated to version 5.0![/h3]

Almost everything has been revamped! We've improved nearly every aspect of the game — from overall balance to the physics engine.
New types of bombs, aircraft, enemies have been added, and now you can upgrade your bombs! Let’s dive into the details.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31669450/397effc0fb531543b19e60eae0095adeb0945c90.png[/img]

[h3][b]New Bombs & Upgrades:[/b][/h3]
We’ve added a variety of new bombs — electric, liquid-based, nuclear, and more! Bombs now have their own dedicated section in the menu.
Bombs are divided into classes: Standard, A, B, C, and Super Heavy. You purchase bombs by class, rather than individually.
New bombs are unlocked using research points, which you earn by leveling up any type of bomb.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31669450/f363c89edb8b5379a81e981e7dfe185f00358cc0.png[/img]

Bomb Upgrades: You can now enhance your bombs! As you use a specific bomb, it gains experience. 
When it levels up, you can upgrade one of its stats — rate of fire, damage, etc.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31669450/607d36f1d61817c76e260b8942a48251cc44becf.png[/img]

[h3][b]Endless Game Mode:[/b][/h3]
The campaign no longer marks the end of your journey — now, an Endless Mode unlocks after completing the main game!
In Endless Mode, enemies grow progressively stronger — and not just tougher, but entirely new enemy types appear.
You’ll first face familiar enemies, but as you advance, new ones start to appear and replace the old. Each era brings a full new set of units!
Your goal: set your personal best by pushing through as many levels as possible. The further you go, the tougher it gets — but the rewards grow too. If you lose, difficulty resets and your high score is saved.
And there’s more: in Endless Mode, you’ll also be able to unlock new aircraft!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31669450/b3076ec92ed0e1382a1883e27b403413a063fc07.png[/img]

[h3][b]New Resources & Power-Ups:[/b][/h3]
We’ve introduced a new resource: Parts. Use them to purchase power-ups like Repair Drones, Extra Fuel Tanks, and more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31669450/78517844f473214f9a8cef952f1f0920c66a73a8.png[/img]

[h3][b]Gameplay Balance Overhaul:[/b][/h3]
We’ve made the early game smoother and more intuitive.
Aircraft and enemy stats have been rebalanced for a more enjoyable and exciting experience.
Enemy projectiles have been resized — they’re now easier to see and dodge.


UI Redesign. The interface has been redesigned with new visuals to better reflect the game’s unique style and atmosphere.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31669450/406ffa03c8476b2db064fb0aca8623a4b66a1038.png[/img]

[h3][b]Technical Improvements:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a new keyboard control mode.
[*] Major performance optimizations — the game now runs smoother and faster.
[*] Reworked camera and object rendering for fluid movement and a better overall experience.
[*] Improved physics system, resulting in smoother object motion and higher performance.
[*] Upgraded the game engine, enhancing load times, performance, and overall stability.
[*] Added translations into several languages.
[/list]


[hr][/hr] 


[i]These are the key improvements in version 5.0. We’ve put a ton of work into making Aircraft Evolution even more fun and immersive!
We truly hope you enjoy the update and that the game brings you even more great experiences![/i]

[b]Have a great time and happy flying![/b]

notes.title: BIG update coming soon!
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello everyone![/h3]

We decided to update Aicraft and breathe new life into it!
We will soon release a huge update to the game!

In it, we have remade almost the entire game! New mechanics will be added,
a new game mode and most importantly - many types of new bombs that can now be upgraded!

[h3]The update will be released in the coming days![/h3]

notes.title: Update 1.0 Release
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31669450/57d6c2778de6b66a0aa12be8daccd07fe35d45c6.png[/img]


[h1]We are happy to announce that Aircraft Evolution is ready for release![/h1]
Thanks to everyone who supported the project in early access and helped improve the game.
This is not the last update, Aircraft Evolution will continue to be updated and grow. A lot of interesting things await you!


[h1]Update 1.0:[/h1]
[list]
     [*]Improved game performance.
     [*]Added shards from an airplane explosion.
     [*]Added a low armor level indicator.
     [*]Added the finishing line in the missions, where you need to fly the distance in time.
     [*]Increased player's rockets speed.
     [*]Increased the speed of projectiles of the player's guns.
     [*]Added the limit for the duration of falling consumables on the levels.
     [*]Improved the effect of smoke from the piles of buildings.
     [*]Improved boot screen.
     [*]The balance of the hitpoints amount in buildings is improved.
     [*]The balance of opponents in the 4th era is revised.
     [*]The physics of the flight of aircrafts in the second era is changed.
     [*]Improved interface textures.
     [*]Interface is corrected.
     [*]Added the ability to reset the saves in the game option.
     [*]In the options, shooting with a machine gun and missiles are combined by pressing one key.
     [*]Increased sensitivity of sound settings in options.
     [*]The sound setting now changes in real time.
     [*]Reduces the hit point of the fourth boss.
     [*]Added additional guns to the fourth boss.
     [*]Fixed a bug where enemy aircraft continued to fire after their destruction.
     [*]Improved tutorial.
     [*]After the explosion of the player's aircraft, a pause was added before the result window was displayed.
[/list]
